description.value: Local Refillery is the Comox Valley's zero-waste bulk grocery and lifestyle store, selling package-free dry foods, fresh and frozen foods, spices, and cleaning and beauty products through a 'weigh and pay' bring-your-own-container model. Shoppers can also order online for in-store or curbside pickup, with staff filling orders into deposit jars or compostable paper bags. Founded by Ginette Matthews and now in its seventh year, the store acts as a community hub for sustainable, plastic-free living in Courtenay.
